correctness.rationale: Each child feasible interval I_c=[l,u] contributes union of integer windows [s-delta_c(s),s] over consecutive s. As each window contains its integer index, their union is exactly [min(s-delta_c(s)),u]; subtree feasibility is an interval by intersection. Disjoint subtrees give exact max-sum Bellman recurrence and weighted interval-stabbing messages. Sorting endpoints, heap maxima and parent difference arrays process S explicitly supplied time-values in O(S log(2+S)) arithmetic/comparisons and O(S) storage. Independently enumerated the four-voter nonconfluence witness. Zero/erratic horizons and signed scores are handled by the structural proof, not the finite verifier.
residual_risks: Fixed unique parent, one contiguous explicit availability interval per vertex, one shared root action; no hierarchy selection, multiple windows, compressed horizon, or bit-complexity bound.
